module: LuaSocket FTP client (Diego Nehab), built on socket.tp and LTN12. Offers a high-level API (get, put, command) accepting an ftp:// URL or a parameters table, and a low-level API (open then greet, login, pasv, send, receive...). The module also registers itself in socket.ftp.
usage:
local ftp = require('libs/luasocket/socket/ftp')
local contenu, err = ftp.get('ftp://anonymous:mdp@serveur/chemin/fichier.txt;type=i')
ftp.put('ftp://user:mdp@serveur/dest.txt', 'données')
notes: The high-level functions are wrapped by socket.protect: on error they return nil, message instead of raising an exception.
Bug: metat.__index:port uses math.mod, absent from LuaJIT/standard Lua 5.1 (replaced by math.fmod): the active mode (PORT) will fail; the passive mode (pasv, used by get/put) is not affected.
Bug: in send, readyt[tp] indexes with the tp module instead of the control socket (so the status check during the transfer is never true).
The file requires 'socket.socket', 'socket.url', 'socket.tp' and 'ltn12' by short name: these names must be resolvable by the game's module search path.
In a request table, the recognized fields: host, port, user, password, type ('a' or 'i'), path, command, argument, source, sink, step, url, create. An explicit field overrides the one from the URL.

TIMEOUT.desc: Timeout in seconds before giving up on a connection: 60.

PASSWORD.desc: Default anonymous password: 'anonymous@anonymous.org' (to be replaced by an e-mail address).

command.desc: ftp.command(cmdt): sends an FTP command (fields host, command, argument, check, user, password...) and closes the connection. Returns 1 or nil, error.

get.desc: ftp.get(url|table): downloads a file. With a URL, returns the content (string); with a table, uses the provided sink.

put.desc: ftp.put(url, body) or ftp.put(table): uploads a file; returns the number of bytes sent.

open.desc: Opens a control connection to an FTP server and returns a low-level object with the methods greet, login, pasv, port, send, receive, cwd, type, quit, close. Raises an error (socket.try) on failure.

connection.desc: Object returned by open (fields tp = control channel, data, server, pasvt, try).

login.desc: Authenticates with USER/PASS (anonymous values by default).

type.desc: Selects the transfer mode ('a' text, 'i' binary).

pasv.desc: Switches to passive mode and stores the data IP and port; returns ip, port.

port.desc: Switches to active mode: announces a local port to the server (opens a server socket if ip is nil). Uses math.mod (see notes).

pasvconnect.desc: Opens the data connection in passive mode.

portconnect.desc: Accepts the data connection in active mode.

send.desc: Sends data (STOR command by default); requires pasv or port beforehand. Returns the number of bytes sent.

sendt.desc: source, path or argument, command, step.

receive.desc: Receives data (RETR command by default) into the provided sink; requires pasv or port beforehand.

recvt.desc: sink, path or argument, command, step.

close.desc: Closes the data, server and control connections.
